subject: Step G: ISO 15924 + 3166 + BCP47 + CLDR decomposers
description: Create src/Hartonomous.Decomposers/Iso/{Iso15924Decomposer.cs, Iso3166Decomposer.cs, Bcp47Decomposer.cs} and src/Hartonomous.Decomposers/Cldr/CldrDecomposer.cs mirroring Iso639Decomposer shape.
